title: WHOISleuth
image_alt: WHOISleuth homepage in dark mode with fictional domain candidates and evidence panels
description: A domain and brand investigation workspace for reviewing evidence, comparing lookalikes and preparing case handoffs.
highlights: Review source-linked registration, DNS, certificate, website and network evidence, including gaps and conflicting observations.
The public demo uses fictional records, with no live investigation or sign-in required.

title: ZoneSkein
image_alt: ZoneSkein homepage introducing its DNS investigation and change-planning workbench
description: A DNS workbench for domain owners and web teams, connecting record inspection with local change plans.
highlights: Compare resolver answers, inspect mail policies and trace DNSSEC trust chains.
Draft and export DNS changes without publishing records or accessing a provider account.

title: Breach Gazette
image_alt: Breach Gazette homepage with notification search and distinct public-record categories
description: A public-data reference for official breach notices, reporting statistics and regulatory actions, with source context kept visible.
highlights: Search and export notification records without treating reports, aggregate figures or legal actions as equivalent.

title: ControlCurrent
image_alt: ControlCurrent homepage comparing Permissions Policy support across desktop and mobile browsers
description: Helps web teams compare browser security support, plan minimum versions and review supplied website evidence.
highlights: The web app reviews evidence locally; it does not scan websites or upload supplied files.

title: ContractDelta AU
image_alt: ContractDelta AU homepage with contract-change totals and links to the published change feed
description: Tracks changes in reported Australian Government contract values, dates and suppliers.
highlights: Before-and-after comparisons link to AusTender records, with timelines and downloadable change data.

title: Forty Life
image_alt: Forty Life multiplayer table with four life counters
description: A touch-friendly Magic: The Gathering life counter for 2-6 players sharing one device.
highlights: Tracks commander damage and poison, with undo, saved games and offline play after the first load.
